latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pptx-to-markdown skill.

- Converts DOCX, PPTX, XLS, XLSX files (local or URL) to Markdown using MinerU Open API.
- No API key, account, or authentication required for quick conversions (up to 10MB/20 pages per document).
- Supports extracting text, tables, and document structure; outputs Markdown only (images as placeholders).
- Simple CLI usage via mineru-open-api flash-extract; works for Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
- Answers to users are always in the same language they use.
